defaultPolicy: Every file in public/ is ORIGINAL placeholder art for the fictional 'Northwind' brand (public/assets/art/ART_MANIFEST.md). Logo, people and screenshot roles are still protected: the measured third-party site's real logos, photos, Lottie art and UI must never be reproduced, and a generator may not fabricate identity assets.

logo.description: The clone's own placeholder brand mark ('Northwind' wordmark, header/footer/menu/favicon). Not the measured site's brand.
logo.licensing: Reuse the exact supplied file. Never redraw it, and never substitute the measured third-party site's real logo.

customer-logo.description: Customer logo tiles (marquee, testimonials, legacy about row). In this clone they are FICTIONAL wordmarks.
customer-logo.licensing: Treat as identity assets: a PageSpec must say source placeholder|supplied. A generator must never draw or reproduce a real company's logo, even though these tiles are fictional.

partner-logo.description: Partner wordmarks (ecosystem tiles, legacy co-brand lockups, legacy pricing logo). FICTIONAL in this clone.
partner-logo.licensing: Never create or reproduce a real partner's mark; use an explicit placeholder or a supplied file.

avatar.licensing: Never generate or reuse a real person's likeness; neutral placeholder only.

author-photo.description: Blog author avatar (byline) and profile photo (placeholder SVG portraits here).
author-photo.licensing: Never generate a real author's photo; neutral placeholder only.

team-photo.description: About-page team/office image (the measured site used a real photo; this clone uses original art).
team-photo.licensing: Never generate or reuse photos of real people or offices.

product-screenshot.description: Product UI visuals: hero tab art, compliance tab images, feature/engine/scroll-tab screenshots, legacy app screenshots (original placeholder UI here).
product-screenshot.licensing: Never present invented UI as a real product's screenshot and never copy the measured site's UI; use a placeholder or a supplied file.

font.description: Figtree variable woff2 + OFL licence (substitute for the commercial Circular Std).
font.licensing: Ship only the OFL Figtree files; never ship Circular Std.

icon.description: Small generic UI glyphs/pictograms (flyout icons, compliance list icons).
icon.licensing: Generic glyphs may be generated; never a brand mark.

illustration.description: Generic decorative vector art (benefit pictograms, get-started illustrations, footer line art, hero-static art).
illustration.licensing: May be regenerated in the same style.

animation.description: Static/animated stand-ins for the original Lottie files (network, roadmap, peace, CTA visuals).
animation.licensing: May be regenerated; keep the original durations (motion contract).

content-image.description: Generic in-page imagery that is none of the protected kinds.
content-image.licensing: May be regenerated; no real customer data or proprietary UI.

editorial-illustration.description: Blog featured images and guide covers (original art here).
editorial-illustration.licensing: May be regenerated; never a real photo of a person.

retrievalRule: Generic decorative roles may be retrieved as decoration. Protected roles are identity assets: only in a section whose contract names them, always with source: placeholder|supplied, never satisfied by a generic asset.
thirdPartyReplaced: HubSpot forms (lead form, guide form, in-article form) and Swiper (CDN) are replaced by static/local look-alikes; no third-party endpoint is loaded.

evidence.note: no reference found in src/ or index.html (kept as spare art)
